title: Chusky has been upgraded
bullets: Added an owner-scoped E2B Playwright/Chromium browser with bounded decisions, headed sessions, accessible controls, navigation, forms, screenshots, and private CAPTCHA/2FA handoff.

Stripe Link purchase requests carry the exact merchant, amount, currency, and owner-visible context; Link owns the approval notification and approval decision before any payment credential is released.
Approved Link credentials stay outside model context, chat history, Redis, and tool arguments; private E2B fills them server-side and never claims success before Link and the merchant confirm it.
